label: 6. There truly are all sorts of people

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: There truly are all sorts of people

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: at Coin Rush.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: The customers who visit this place, in particular,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: have an atmosphere

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: quite different from those who visit Maid For You.
How are they different?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I would say that

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: while both come in pursuit of enjoyment,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: the kind of enjoyment they seek is quite different.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Perhaps that is why the manner in which the staff here

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: receive their guests feels distinctly different from our own.
Yeah, bunny girl outfits and maid uniforms have completely different vibes.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Oh, no.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I wasn't referring to the outfits,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: but rather to the manner in which we serve others.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Naturally,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: the attire is of importance as well, but
Haha, relax.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Sorry T_T
So what do you think the difference between the two is?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: We seek to satisfy our patrons

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: through composed, personalized service tailored to their wishes.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Here at Coin Rush, however,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: it feels as though the staff present dazzling performances and services

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: to delight the guests

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: even before they have fully formed a desire in their minds.
I think I get what you mean.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Yes,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: watching them has taught me many things.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I realize that there are various ways

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: to serve and bring satisfaction to others.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: If I have the opportunity,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I would like to learn their methods as well.
So does that mean I'll get to see you working at Coin Rush in a bunny girl outfit?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Um, well...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Even if I were to master the methods,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: working at Coin Rush as part of Maid For You might be a bit problematic.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Not that it's strictly impossible,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: but maybe it could work if I did house-call maid services instead.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Though in that case,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I don't think I could wear a bunny girl outfit T_T
Just kidding, haha.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I suppose...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: If that is your wish, Master,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: once I have learned their methods,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I shall invite you to experience my new services.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Until then, I ask for your patience.
Will you be in a bunny girl outfit?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Yes...
Then I'll be looking forward to it.
